o: When Jimmy and his MrBeast crew discovered weird shadow monsters attacking Earth, he did what any YouTuber would - built a high-tech science lab underneath his studio. But 100 levels of insane experiments and creating all kinds of weird beasts to battle the shadowy invaders, unfortunately didn’t prevent him getting kidnapped! Jimmy is now trapped in his own high tech lair… Many battles await…

eps.o: While chasing Jimmy and the Shrouds, Panthar is intercepted by Beastbot, who mistakes him for an intruder. Banana appears, and together with Beastbot, they give us the typical informational episode. Panthar and you will find out what this series is all about!

Our team has now lived through a few levels, and after clearing the random pixel level, the heroes arrive in a jungle level that is rotting. Spike & Sprout and the Swarms have been poisoned and turned into zombies. It’s up to them to find a way through the chaos and survive this Night of the Undead Swarm Zombies.... Swarmbies.
